article_title: Ananda Brick Monastery Inscriptions of Pagan
script_or_transliteration: English-rendered OCR of source-variant footnotes with B1/P2/B2 witness labels
source_text: Homage to the Omniscient Buddha whose knowledge covers all things! ... to the Exalted Buddha, the Omniscient One! B2. May this Brick Monastery remain long in the Sāsana! B1; May this three tiered Brick Monastery remain long! P2 & B2. After this P2 & B2 add: "May it contribute to my attainment of nibbāna, so do I aspire!" ... commencing on Friday the 15th and fullmoon day of the bright half of the month of Pusya ... in the year 1137 of the Gawza Era (A.D. 1775), P2 ... B2 ... 100 coins, B1, P2 & B2. If somebody asks as to its builder, B1 & B2. Uttanarājā, B1 & P2.
